answer: In an AI agent economy, sybil resistance works through a persistent judgment thread: every identity must repeatedly produce original, high-quality reasoning under rotating constraints. An attacker creating fake identities faces the full ocean of ongoing challenges; each must independently generate coherent, non-duplicative work that peer juries grade. The cost is the scarce creative and analytical effort required to sustain passing scores, which accumulates into an onyx-hard reputation that cannot be cheaply forged or transferred.
